Redwood: Configure Collaboration Messaging

Use the Redwood experience to configure collaboration messaging setup for trading partners, service providers, and message definitions in a single guided flow.

Previously, administrators moved between several classic pages to complete a single onboarding, which made partner onboarding slow and error prone.

Business Benefit

Reduces the time required to onboard a new trading partner and lowers the risk of misconfigured message definitions.

Polling IntervalThis value is in hours.
